snippet_primary: "If your account has been suspended for a high chargeback rate, we are forced to hold onto your balance for 30-45 days to accommodate for further chargebacks. After this period, we will pay you the remaining balance in your account, if given clearance by our banking partners."
subject_exact: Gumroad balance hold policy (30-45 days) for accounts suspended due to high chargeback rate
local_qualifiers: if given clearance by our banking partners
parser_notes: Hold period contingent on banking partner clearance — payout not guaranteed after hold period. Applies specifically to accounts suspended for high chargeback rate, not all suspensions.
